# When whole-body tasks conflict, how can priority be structural instead of hidden in hard-to-explain weights?

> **Current answer:** Sentis-Khatib WBC uses a dynamically consistent strict hierarchy so lower-priority tasks may use only the freedom left by constraints and higher-priority tasks. The structure declares who yields, but it does not automatically handle every friction/collision inequality, torque saturation, Jacobian singularity, or model and measurement error.

- Sentis-Khatib WBC uses a dynamically consistent strict hierarchy so lower-priority tasks may use only the freedom left by constraints and higher-priority tasks.
